title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence in Construction: The Content, Context, Process, Outcome Evaluation Framework
findings: This paper does not discuss, analyze, or mention any aspects of religion or faith. The content is exclusively focused on proposing an evaluation framework for Explainable AI (XAI) within the construction sector, addressing topics like business value, stakeholder management, and technology adoption.
